description: Deployments: ways to put a Component together, each placing named Instances of its children and of the Components it imports, each with a range of how many occupy it, and Connections from an Instance to what offers the Interactions it uses. A Connection to a ranged Instance reaches every occupant. Optional: a Component with no Deployment is complete. Extends Contexts.

axioms.about: An Instance's min <= max, where max is present
axioms.formula: all i in Instance, m in i.max. i.min <= m

axioms.about: An Instance is of a child of the deployed Component, or of a Component it imports
axioms.formula: all i in Instance, k in i.deployment.component. i.of in k.components or i.of in k.imports.from or i.of in k.imports.exports.component

axioms.about: An Instance of a Component from beyond what the deployed Component's ancestors hold is of one its parent exports
axioms.formula: all i in Instance, k in i.deployment.component, p in i.of.parent. p in k.*parent or (some e in Export. e.component == i.of)

axioms.about: No two Instances of a Deployment share a name
axioms.formula: all a in Instance, b in Instance. (a != b and a.deployment == b.deployment) => a.name != b.name

axioms.about: A Connection goes from an Instance of its own Deployment
axioms.formula: all c in Connection. c.from.deployment == c.deployment

axioms.about: A Connection goes to exactly one thing: an Instance, or the deployed Component
axioms.formula: all c in Connection. (some c.to and no c.toComponent) or (no c.to and some c.toComponent)

axioms.about: A Connection goes to an Instance of its own Deployment
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, t in c.to. t.deployment == c.deployment

axioms.about: A Connection to a Component goes to the deployed Component
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, k in c.toComponent. k == c.deployment.component

axioms.about: The Instance a Connection goes to offers its What: its own, or one of an API it exports
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what, t in c.to. i.component == t.of or i.component in t.of.exports.component

axioms.about: The deployed Component a Connection goes to offers or imports its What
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what, k in c.toComponent. i.component == k or i.component in k.exports.component or i in k.imports.exports.interaction

axioms.about: A Connection's What is accessible to the Component it goes from
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, i in c.what, f in c.from.of. i.component in f.*parent or i in f.imports.exports.interaction

axioms.about: A Connection's What is over one Language
axioms.formula: all c in Connection, a in c.what, b in c.what. a.language == b.language
